title: Union
description: A partnership. Stored at unions/<id>.json. Children are deliberately not listed here; parentage lives on the child so partial and messy data still loads.

id.description: Zero-padded, monotonic, never reused. Equals the filename.

partners.description: One or more people. One partner is legal for a single parent or an unknown other party; three or more is legal and gets no special casing.

endReason.description: A key from vocab.unionEnd, or null while the union is ongoing.

date.description: EDTF subset, parsed by src/model/date.ts. The parser is the authority on what is well formed; null means unknown.
